head: a7efcac
summary:
NOT READY FOR CUTOVER. Bounded, privacy-safe shadow harness and complete evidence/runbook delivered.
Release build/format and 1,559 fast tests pass; 141 distinct heavy cases pass across a disclosed 138/3 initial run and three repaired-prerequisite reruns.
Final owned boundary: eight xUnit, 24 Python, 31 inherited SQL fixtures, three templates and three ownership cases pass.
Fresh API: 1,514 steps/2,311 raw fields; independent gateway: 255 HTTP/523 raw fields, adjusted 236/255.
Exact current policy retains 637 unresolved fields; framework is sub-40 cap-exempt, not repaired.
Seven canonical cross-surface comparisons match; 18 paired synthetic read samples retain first/warm timings and no observed HTTP/transport failures.
Live approval exists, but capacity/access is unproved due missing Warehouse configuration: zero live data attempts.
Conductor no_halt repair: superseded W3 stop archived byte-for-byte; all 28 required owner decisions retained. Focused Python tests: 24/24.
No protected writes, scratch, deployment, traffic switch, product/contract changes or push. No new product waivers.

deviations.what: Live coverage is explicitly unmeasured; I3 is partial.
deviations.why: Current approval is insufficient without capacity/configuration, safe runtime endpoints/read-only credentials and proven ingress/employer/right/destination binding. No activation or provisioning is authorized.

deviations.what: Historical framework-cap halt is not a current scoring blocker.
deviations.why: Current cap_min_exchanges=40 exempts 17 framework exchanges; nine waived passes/52.94% and all raw differences remain visible. Superseded HALT-integrate-W3.md is preserved byte-for-byte at dotnet/docs/waves/W3-policy-stop.md; the actual conductor checks all HALT*.md in docs roots, not just this session's filename. All substantive owner decisions remain open.

deviations.what: Drafts score 312/323 under exact current patterns, not the old helper's 313/323.
deviations.why: p2_run_batches:unknown-client detail.detail is not a globally free current path. It remains unresolved; no regex or source register was broadened.

deviations.what: Heavy evidence is 141 distinct passing cases across disclosed runs, not an initially green monolithic run.
deviations.why: Three inherited executable tests require hard-coded Debug host DLLs absent after Release-only build. Building those prerequisites and rerunning exactly the failures passes all three without product/test edits.

deviations.what: Shadow-owned launch/build setup replaces neither product behavior nor contract setup.
deviations.why: Direct Release DLL launch avoids the old launcher's root SDK selection. Explicit owned-project build prevents a stale out-of-solution executable. Public fixture commit metadata is preserved; initial setup attempts are retained separately.

deviations.what: Native eligibility and draft reads were slower in the small local HTTP sample.
deviations.why: Shared-workstation, synthetic SQLite observations are not production regressions or live Fabric speedups; no SLO or acceptance threshold exists.

findings: M-01 overrides year-resolved wage_basis/measuring_date/pay codes despite ADR-005. Preserve figures until statutory/domain reconciliation.
First-program multi-program pricing, zero-worksite SQL/projector, leap/context, QC-drop, legacy fiscal/year/benefit and historical override-order seams remain inherited figure-sensitive decisions.
F-14's four named valid-request reader exceptions remain owner-sensitive; general writer policy is not permission to change them.
Standalone gateway remains 19 cases/49 fields short: two MCP person-lane refusals/16, two missing-dataset catalogues/17, fifteen real allocation-drift cases/16.
Native monetary AVG/decimal string scale, metadata, schema/grants and supplemental operational tables are not proved by SQLite or typed payload tests.
Unknown-client nested error wording is outside exact current global paths. Recorded list metadata semantics supersede obsolete page-independent demands.
Gateway read tools audit, links mint tickets and downloads can consume/audit. None is a live read-only mirror.
Override save/queue acceptance is non-atomic; synchronous compute has a 600-second lease without periodic renewal.
Gateway key exclusion is host-local; orchestrator checkpoints/budgets are in-memory and production resultLookup/recovery endpoint is absent.
Private 10,236/539/656 is not certified; all eleven sealed operations stay unavailable. Synthetic 81/51/49 is distinct.
open_questions: The named owners must accept or repair the source-linked producer residuals before a traffic slice.
Approved live runtime inputs, actual native rights/type/schema evidence, trusted ingress and employer binding remain unavailable.
Production SLO, workload, evidence freshness window, observation period and rollback thresholds are unset.
Fleet idempotency, restart/replica checkpoint retention and uncertain-write recovery require an explicit operational design.

needs_human.why: Reconcile ingestion overrides versus ADR-005; no figure change without owner approval.
Decide contextual first-program pricing while preserving the current valid figures.
Resolve SQL COALESCE versus falsy projector fallback and quantify the figure impact.
Design a context-carrying inward fiscal port before changing strict leap-shift/calendar fallback behavior.
Prove native AVG/datetime/DECIMAL metadata and agree exact decimal-string scale; no float or scale waiver.
Decide and reconcile whether persisted QC-drop annotations affect actual run computation.
Reconcile legacy fiscal/tax-year/scalar-benefit paths without unilateral changes.
A new sequence cannot recover historical equal-time intent; ambiguous history needs explicit reconciliation.
Decide the four named valid-request reader entitlement exceptions explicitly.
Reconcile two MCP person-derived fact refusals; privacy rationale is not a missing-fact waiver.
Bind payroll/location/pay_code and verify the complete eleven-dataset catalogue/query contract.
Resolve genuine post-preview identity-allocation history without dummy draws or response rewrites.
Choose a compatible contract for long valid program/rule text that currently exceeds storage limits; never truncate or waive a 500.
Repair exact current status/stored-program/base-year/run-ID/scale residuals. Conductor policy review is needed if nested detail.detail wording is intended free.
Apply reviewed Python forward migrations/grants, including supplemental audit/sequence/work/source tables, and prove native behavior.
Agree atomicity or explicit repair for saved override intent with failed queue acceptance; an unchanged resave is not repair.
Prove long native work and recovery under the non-heartbeating 600-second synchronous-compute lease.
Accept count/max limitations or supply a stronger version source; it is not snapshot/sync-lag/freshness proof.
Prove safe real exporter receipt/redaction; instrumentation registration or unmerged assets are insufficient.
Prove trusted header stripping/replacement, direct-origin isolation, audience/acting-person validity and employer binding.
Agree durable fleet key exclusion/retention or a reviewed single-authority constraint.
Agree restart/replica affinity and retention for process-local checkpoints, confirmations and budgets.
Design recovery for unknown acknowledgements; there is no production resultLookup/recovery endpoint and blind retry is unsafe.
Approve one writer/Worker authority and one accepted Gold/manifest destination, including in-flight lease drain/reconciliation.
Keep package generations, metadata, bytes, access audit and expiring/single-use tickets coherent through transition/rollback.
Obtain separately approved private-extract reconciliation before certifying 10,236/539/656 or moving any sealed operation.
Supply runtime-only safe approved inputs and fresh current admission; no activation, deployment or new grants in shadow.
Agree workload, freshness/observation windows and median/tail/failure acceptance criteria before any slice.
